name: Automatic Light Bracket Placement Machine
summary: Precisely picks and places diffusion brackets, providing stable support for display device optical components. Accurate positioning and high-speed picking.
contentHtml:
The automatic light bracket placement machine is used for precise placement of diffusion bracket posts during display product assembly.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a vibration bowl for automatic feeding, and the robot precisely picks bracket posts and places them at designated positions. Positioning accuracy reaches ±0.2mm, with a picking speed of 1 second per piece.

Technical Advantages

  • Positioning accuracy of ±0.2mm, ensuring assembly precision
  • High-speed picking, capable of thousands per hour
  • Automatic vibration bowl feeding reduces manual intervention
  • Multiple models TX-NS-ALPS-01/02/03, adaptable to different sizes and production needs
